description: Apply the Cream theme polish with the current AGENTS.md rules. Correct the partial edits of the canceled run. Cream accent is dark forest green; text on a Cream green fill (wordmark, primary button) is cream; all other Cream text and lines are black. Active tabs get a 4px accent rule above them and a 1px ink rule as the active-state marker, with no green text. Add --color-input-border. Update the docs/theme.md contrast table and regenerate the Cream screenshots. Add exactly two approved tests. Do not edit AGENTS.md or the decision tables (docs/fork-plan.md, docs/implementation-plan.md). Do not change the Cream default, the Storage setting, or the SIGTERM behavior. Do not commit.
steps: Read AGENTS.md, src/renderer/src/styles.css, src/renderer/src/StorageView.tsx, src/main/launch.ts, src/main/preferences.ts, tests/platform.spec.ts, tests/runtime.test.ts, and docs/theme.md first. Also read tests/theme.spec.ts, tests/ui.ts, src/renderer/src/App.tsx (header nav), and src/renderer/src/SharingView.tsx (sharing tabs).

Cream accent tokens (src/renderer/src/styles.css, `:root[data-theme="cream"]`). Keep --color-accent at the dark forest green oklch(46.1% 0.121 145) (#216929) that is already there, unless the contrast computation shows a problem. Keep --color-accent-ink as a cream paper token so the wordmark and the primary button (`button`, `.button-link`) have cream text. Add Cream overrides so that all other Cream text and lines are black: --color-accent-text: var(--color-ink); --color-accent-line: var(--color-ink); --color-focus: var(--color-ink). Keep --color-accent-edge as the accent so the primary button border matches its fill. Do not change Terminal token values except the new input border token. Rewrite the Cream comment above the block and the 'Roles of the accent' comment in :root so that they state the current rule (green only as a fill with cream text and as the 4px tab rule; all other Cream text and lines are ink). Use ASD-STE100 style.

Active tab rule (src/renderer/src/styles.css). AGENTS.md says both variants use the same components, and the decision table says both variants use the same selected-tab style, so write the rules once (not scoped to Cream) with role tokens. Header nav: replace the current `.header-start nav a[aria-current="page"]::after` 2px accent bar with (a) `::before` a 4px rule at the top edge, background var(--color-accent), and (b) `::after` a 1px rule at the bottom edge, background var(--color-ink). Keep the active text color var(--color-ink). Update the comment above it. Sharing tabs: change `.sharing-tabs a[aria-current="page"]` so the text color is var(--color-ink) (no green text) and the top border is no longer the accent; add a `::before` 4px var(--color-accent) rule along the top edge that covers the 1px top border cleanly (the tab has `position: relative` and a 1px border, so offset the pseudo-element by -1px left/right/top as needed), and an `::after` 1px var(--color-ink) rule at the bottom edge as the active-state marker. Use only role tokens, no literal colors. No shadows, no rounded corners.

Input border token (src/renderer/src/styles.css). Add `--color-input-border` to `:root` (Terminal) and `:root[data-theme="cream"]`. Terminal: a new OKLCH value in the hue family of the existing rule tokens (hue 146 to 150, low chroma like --color-rule-2) with a contrast ratio of at least 3:1 against --color-paper oklch(12.5% 0.012 150). Cream: a high-contrast border, var(--color-ink) (black, which matches the rule that Cream lines are black). Compute every ratio with a correct OKLCH -> OKLab -> linear sRGB -> WCAG relative luminance conversion, using a throwaway script in the OS temp folder (not in the repository); delete it after. Report the ratios against paper and paper-2.

Use var(--color-input-border) for the border of the `input { ... }` rule and the select rule `.sharing-section select, .panel select, .relay-inbox select, .import-dialog select, .appearance select { ... }`. Keep the hover, focus, and disabled rules. Do not change .path, .panel, or other non-input borders. Record in findings that selects are included.

docs/theme.md. Update the Contrast table so that every row matches the new tokens and uses: Cream green on paper and paper-2 is used only as the 4px selected-tab rule (not text, not focus); Cream links, status text, and focus are ink (add or adjust rows, e.g. 'Ink on paper | 17.6 | Body text, links, status text, focus'); keep 'Paper-2 on green' for the primary button and wordmark; add 'Input border on paper' rows for Cream and Terminal with the computed ratios; replace the Terminal row 'Rule-2 on paper | 2.1 | Input edges. Below 3:1...' so that it no longer says that inputs use rule-2. Recompute every ratio that you change. The Role tokens table and the Selected tab table in docs/theme.md are not decision tables; update only the rows that become false (add --color-input-border; change the Cream values of --color-focus and --color-accent-text/-line; change the Selected tab rows to the 4px accent rule above and 1px ink rule below with ink text), and change the sentence under the Role tokens table that says the green can mark text, rules, and focus. Record each of these doc edits in findings. Do not edit docs/fork-plan.md, docs/implementation-plan.md, or AGENTS.md. Use ASD-STE100 style.

Export requireRunArguments from src/main/launch.ts (`function requireRunArguments` -> `export function requireRunArguments`). Do not change its behavior, runInteractive, the SIGTERM handling, or any other code in launch.ts.

Approved test 1 (--interactive argument parsing) in tests/runtime.test.ts: add ONE node:test `test(...)` that imports requireRunArguments from '../src/main/launch.ts' and checks the real function: `['run', '--interactive', '--', 'pwsh', '-NoLogo']` gives { interactive: true, projectName: undefined, executable: 'pwsh', commandArgs: ['-NoLogo'] }; `['run', '--interactive', 'Demo', '--', 'bash']` gives { interactive: true, projectName: 'Demo', executable: 'bash', commandArgs: [] }; `['run', '--', 'node', 'server.cjs']` gives interactive false; `['run', '--interactive', '--']` throws /Usage: sct run \[--interactive\]/. Use assert.deepEqual and assert.throws. No skip on Windows.

Approved test 2 (theme preference survives an app restart): tests/theme.spec.ts already exists from the canceled run with the test 'Cream is the default and the selected theme stays after a restart'. Keep it as the one approved theme test. Read it, confirm it follows the restart pattern (temp root, userData with settings.json, electron-entry.cjs, unlock helper, rm in finally) and checks: first window data-theme cream, select Dark (Terminal) in Storage > Theme, data-theme terminal, preferences.json { theme: 'dark' }, close, relaunch, data-theme terminal before unlock, Theme select value dark. Correct it only if it is wrong. Do not add other tests or change other existing tests.

Run `bun run build`, then visually confirm without adding tests (use a throwaway Playwright Electron script in the OS temp folder, delete it after): in Cream and Terminal, the active header tab and the active sharing tab have a 4px ::before with the accent color and a 1px ink ::after; active tab text is the ink color; Cream links and focus rings are ink; the wordmark and primary button text are cream on green in Cream; input and select borders use the new token. Record the computed style values in findings.

Regenerate the four Cream screenshots in docs/media/themes/cream/ (unlock.png, projects.png, sharing.png, storage.png) at 1200x800 on Windows with the same throwaway-script approach (temp userData, no preferences.json so Cream is the default; the same screens as the current files: unlock screen, Projects, Sharing (Relay tab), Storage). Open each PNG to confirm that it shows the new styles. Do not change the Terminal screenshots; record in findings that the Terminal screenshots now show the old tab and input-border style, so the orchestrator can ask the user.

Run all checks from the repository root: `bun run check`, `bun run test`, `bun run typecheck:tsc`, `bun run build`, `bun run react-doctor`; then from tests/: `bunx playwright test --config ../playwright.config.ts platform.spec.ts` (Windows smoke test) and `bunx playwright test --config ../playwright.config.ts theme.spec.ts`. Fix only failures that this task causes. Compare with the FEAT-001 baseline. A failure in src/main/sharing.ts, src/main/index.ts, or src/shared/transport.ts can come from the concurrent transport task; report it with the error text and do not edit those files.
Record in findings the list of files that this task changed and the result of every command.
acceptance_criteria: Cream: --color-accent is dark forest green; the wordmark and primary button text are cream; --color-accent-text, --color-accent-line, and --color-focus resolve to ink, so no Cream text or line other than the 4px tab rule is green
In both variants, the active header tab and the active sharing tab show a 4px var(--color-accent) rule at the top and a 1px var(--color-ink) rule at the bottom; active tab text is var(--color-ink)

--color-input-border exists in both :root blocks; the Terminal value has at least 3:1 contrast against --color-paper (computed number reported); the Cream value is var(--color-ink); input and select borders use the token
docs/theme.md contrast table matches the new tokens with recomputed ratios; docs/fork-plan.md, docs/implementation-plan.md, and AGENTS.md are unchanged by this task
docs/media/themes/cream/{unlock,projects,sharing,storage}.png are regenerated at 1200x800 and show the new styles
requireRunArguments is exported and its behavior is unchanged; SIGTERM handling, the Cream default, and the Storage setting are unchanged
Exactly two approved tests exist for this task: one node:test in tests/runtime.test.ts for --interactive parsing and the Playwright test in tests/theme.spec.ts; both pass on Windows

bun run check, bun run test, bun run typecheck:tsc, bun run build, bun run react-doctor, and the Windows Playwright smoke test pass, or each failure is shown to come from the baseline or from the concurrent task
verification: cd tests; bunx playwright test --config ../playwright.config.ts platform.spec.ts
cd tests; bunx playwright test --config ../playwright.config.ts theme.spec.ts
